definitions.explanation: Resting the body and mind to recover health and vitality, often by going to a quiet or scenic location such as a hot spring resort or the countryside.

examples.japanese: {温泉|おんせん}で{保養|ほよう}する。
{医者|いしゃ}に{保養|ほよう}を{勧|すす}められた。
examples.english: The doctor recommended rest and recuperation.

examples.japanese: {仕事|しごと}の{疲|つか}れを{癒|いや}すために、{山|やま}の{保養|ほよう}{施設|しせつ}で{一週間|いっしゅうかん}{過|す}ごした。
examples.english: I spent a week at a mountain retreat to recover from work fatigue.

notes:
Implies a more deliberate, extended period of rest than simply taking a break. Often associated with travel to resorts, hot springs ({温泉|おんせん}), or countryside locations for health recovery. In Japan, many companies and organizations maintain {保養所|ほようじょ} (rest houses, retreats) for their employees.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{保養|ほよう}{地|ち} (resort, health resort)
・{保養|ほよう}{所|じょ} (rest house, retreat facility)
・{保養|ほよう}{施設|しせつ} (recuperation facility)
・{保養|ほよう}に{行|い}く (go to recuperate)
・{心身|しんしん}の{保養|ほよう} (rest for body and mind)
